scripts.build: VERSION=$(bun -e "console.log(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(await Bun.file('package.json').text()).version))") && bun build src/cli/index.ts --compile --define PACKAGE_VERSION=$VERSION --outfile out/scraper
scripts.build:linux: VERSION=$(bun -e "console.log(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(await Bun.file('package.json').text()).version))") && bun build src/cli/index.ts --compile --target bun-linux-x64 --define PACKAGE_VERSION=$VERSION --outfile out/ig-scraper-linux
scripts.build:macos-x64: VERSION=$(bun -e "console.log(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(await Bun.file('package.json').text()).version))") && bun build src/cli/index.ts --compile --target bun-darwin-x64 --define PACKAGE_VERSION=$VERSION --outfile out/ig-scraper-macos-x64
scripts.build:macos-arm64: VERSION=$(bun -e "console.log(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(await Bun.file('package.json').text()).version))") && bun build src/cli/index.ts --compile --target bun-darwin-arm64 --define PACKAGE_VERSION=$VERSION --outfile out/ig-scraper-macos-arm64
scripts.build:windows: VERSION=$(bun -e "console.log(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(await Bun.file('package.json').text()).version))") && bun build src/cli/index.ts --compile --target bun-windows-x64 --define PACKAGE_VERSION=$VERSION --outfile out/ig-scraper-windows.exe
scripts.build:all: bun run build:linux && bun run build:macos-x64 && bun run build:macos-arm64 && bun run build:windows
